title: Cybersecurity Assessment Lead
description: Cybersecurity Assessment Lead KPMG Jamaica (JESS) Kingston and St. Andrew / St. Catherine Not disclosed Permanent full-time Updated 28/10/2026 HR Log in or register to apply Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save In this role, you will serve as a trusted cybersecurity advisor, helping the Client securely adopt and manage applications, cloud services, artificial intelligence solutions, and emerging technologies. OVERVIEW: KPMG Jamaica has a delivery center named Jamaica Extended Support Services (“JESS”) operating from Kingston, which is contracted to provide support to its member firm KPMG United States (“the Client”). JOB SUMMARY: In this role, you will serve as a trusted cybersecurity advisor, helping the Client securely adopt and manage applications, cloud services, artificial intelligence solutions, and emerging technologies. You will provide strategic oversight across the security assessment lifecycle, translating complex technical risks into clear business decisions and guiding stakeholders toward practical, risk-informed solutions. Through cross-functional leadership, sound judgement, and the effective use of AI-enabled tools, you will strengthen the Client’s security readiness, support responsible innovation, and help ensure that technology initiatives are delivered securely and efficiently. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Service Delivery Lead security assessments for applications, infrastructure, cloud services, AI solutions, and emerging technologies. Identify risks, define security requirements, and document risk treatment and residual risk decisions. Coordinate security testing activities, including AI Red Teaming, application penetration testing, static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), and open-source software reviews. Drive remediation and risk mitigation efforts in partnership with development teams and specialized security functions. Provide expertise across multiple security domains and advise on compensating controls where requirements cannot be met. Use AI-assisted tools and techniques as part of daily operations to improve assessment effectiveness, productivity, and decision-making. Stakeholder Management Own stakeholder engagement strategy, anticipating needs, managing expectations, and proactively addressing concerns before escalation. Actively manage stakeholder landscape, building trust, influencing decisions, and strengthening relationships to enable program success. Own stakeholder communication strategy, delivering proactive, value-focused updates that highlight outcomes, risks, decisions, and business impact. Proactively identify and escalate issues to the Portfolio Manager and JESS leadership, and recommend corrective action in a timely manner. Effectively communicate with stakeholders to understand any changes to the program's policies, processes, and procedures and implement affected changes. EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field Minimum of five (5) years relevant work experience performing cybersecurity risk assessments, security architecture reviews, or security consulting activities for technology initiatives. Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) and/or Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) certification is preferred. Demonstrated ability to identify risks, evaluate security controls, and drive remediation activities. Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools to enhance security assessments, streamline risk analysis, improve operational efficiency, and support data-driven decision-making. Ability to positively influence and mentor less experienced team members and serve as a credible source of knowledge. Solid verbal/written communication, problem-solving, analytical, and independent judgement skills to support an environment driven by customer service and teamwork Strong problem-solving skills, project management skills, and attention to detail Ability to work independently and work well within a team Strong organizational and time management skills; ability to adhere to deadlines Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook SPECIAL CONDITIONS JESS uses a hybrid work model, allowing staff to work from home in Jamaica or in the office. Employees must be in the office at least five days per month, with more days possible if required by business needs. You are expected to use KPMG-approved Generative AI tools to support your daily work tasks. Expected to work in a fast-paced team environment. Will be working primarily in a paperless environment and expected to be using information systems for the entire workday to access data or perform activities. May be required to work extended hours periodically or on public holidays.
